# Canonical security-offerings consumer regression fixture

This fixture is an exact peer-authority and instance snapshot from `canonical-cloud/canonical-docs` PR #18 at head `e46161ddef643848b5bc7391704e21c6ccaddf15`.

It exists only to regression-test TJSV handling of a realistic consumer contract containing string enums, booleans, optional integer fields, arrays of strings, arrays of enum references, absolute `$id`/`$ref` resolution, and a mixed valid/invalid differential corpus.

Canonical Cloud's source repository remains the commercial/documentation authority. This copy is test evidence only and must not be edited as a pricing authority.
